target_reference_entry:

RFID by capturing sub-mm level vibration,” Proc. ACM Interact.,
Mobile, Wearable Ubiquitous Technol., vol. 5, no. 4, pp. 1–25,
Dec. 2021.
paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文将目标论文（[12]）归类为RFID被动振动感知方法，在相关工作部分简要提及，作为被动感知的代表性工作之一。

evidences.evidence_quote: For instance, Wang et al. [12] utilized radio-frequency identification (RFID) to receive the speaker’s vibration signal in the environment.
evidences.evidence_context: The method of indirect voice recovery by sensing the vibrations of surrounding objects can be seen as passive sensing. For instance, Wang et al. [12] utilized radio-frequency identification (RFID) to receive the speaker’s vibration signal in the environment. This approach requires a preinstalled tag in the victim’s room.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用仅将[12]作为被动RFID振动感知的示例，没有明确提及sub-mm、精度、首次、能力等关键属性，属于普通相关工作总结，不符合include标准。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 目标论文[12]被引用为RFID被动振动感知的代表性工作，但未获得亚毫米级精度或能力方面的明确肯定。
